name: FileInput
intro: Root connects the file control, dropzone, instructions, error, and preview parts.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: Owns accepted files and rejects the entire selection if any file fails accept validation.

props.name: errorText
props.description: Message for rejected files. Defaults to "Error: This is not a valid file type."
props.defaultValue: "Error: This is not a valid file type."

props.name: ariaDisabled
props.description: Marks the input disabled for assistive technology while keeping it operable.

props.name: ids
props.type: { root?: string; label?: string; dropzone?: string; box?: string; input?: string; instructions?: string; itemGroup?: string; previewHeading?: string; srStatus?: string; errorText?: string }
props.description: Overrides generated part IDs. Use Root IDs when a label or external control needs a stable input or trigger target.

parts.name: SrStatus
parts.description: Announces file selection status after a one-second delay. Initially disabled inputs hide this region.

parts.name: Dropzone
parts.description: Displays the drag and drop target.

parts.name: Input
parts.description: Native file input over the dropzone. Pass native name, required, and onChange props here.

parts.name: Instructions
parts.description: Explains how to choose files; children replace the default text.

parts.name: PreviewHeader
parts.description: Groups the preview heading and change action.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: Provides one file to the preview parts.

props.name: file
props.description: The file represented by this item.

parts.name: ItemPreview
parts.description: Arranges the preview icon, image, and file name.

data.value: pdf | word | excel | video | generic | image

parts.name: ItemPreviewImage
parts.description: Displays an image thumbnail when available.

parts.name: ItemName
parts.description: Displays the file name by default.

parts.name: ChangeTrigger
parts.description: Displays decorative change-files text. The overlaid native Input opens the file picker.
